AS01.question: I want to see whether my middle fingertip leaves the sticker before a slow R turn ends. Give two practical ways to tell, one live and one on replay, taking at most 71 seconds together. Each heading should be written as a name followed by a colon and its seconds. At the end, in a separate paragraph, ask Noor in one sentence to film both on Tuesday.

value.answer:
Live check — Slow-Motion Mirror: 40 seconds: turn R slowly while watching your middle fingertip in a mirror or phone front camera, and note whether the fingertip visibly separates from the sticker before the turn finishes. Replay check — Frame-by-Frame Clip: 31 seconds: film the slow R from the side at high frame rate, then scrub the clip frame by frame to see whether the fingertip leaves the sticker before the last frame of the turn.

Noor, please film both of these on Tuesday.
